# RecipeLinkCard

A tappable card linking a meal to its recipe: a portrait thumbnail, "RECIPE" label, serif name, meta line and a chevron.

`NomNom.RecipeLinkCard` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.RecipeLinkCard name="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.RecipeLinkCard" name="…"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `'square' \| 'portrait' \| 'landscape'` | The thumbnail's PhotoCard format. @default 'portrait' |
| `name` * | `string` |  |
| `photo` | `string` |  |
| `eyebrow` | `string` | @default 'Recipe' |
| `meta` | `string[]` | Joined with " · ", e.g. ['30–60 min', 'Baking', 'Pizza']. |
| `href` | `string` |  |
